notes.title: Pre-Alpha Testing
notes.notes:
Signups are open to begin testing braverBOTS! We will periodically be hosting tournaments in the coming weeks, to get feedback and begin incorporating the community as we push towards a full release.

This Saturday, 5/4/24 @ 12pm PT, we will be hosting an open tournament. All participants will permanently unlock an account-bound "Alpha Tester" skin.

We'd appreciate the support as we begin stress testing our game! If you are interested, tell any/all friends and join our discord server here for more details:

notes.title: Welcome to braverBOTS!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43509037/8ab2284343eebf56b5fe0ed220a4e05fab5c7556.png[/img]

We’re excited to share our demo of [b]braverBOTS [/b]with you. This slice of gameplay will show you the direction the project is taking. This is our first release of a PVP game, and so we encourage all new players to join our discord @ [url=https://discord.gg/zAxAvDsPdt]https://discord.gg/zAxAvDsPdt[/url], especially if you are experiencing high wait times for a match.

Discord is the best way to interact with the developers, make comments / recommendations / suggestions, and also to find matches against other players. Please help us reach our goal of making [b]braverBOTS [/b]an exciting and robust experience for all fans of strategy games, robots, and ascending ranked ladders.

notes.title: braverBOTS Demo
notes.notes:
[h1]braverBOTS Demo is LIVE[/h1]

Hey all, our first playable look at braverBOTS is LIVE on Steam. We want to make a great game, but we can't do it alone. Your feedback is vital to a healthy, successful project. So please download braverBOTS and help us test and improve our game!

Download our demo here -
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2157940/braverBOTS/
